Name: Steel Industry Energy Consumption
Summary: Electricity records from a small-scale steel plant in South Korea, with reactive power, power factor, CO2 and a light, medium or maximum load label.
Description:
Steel Industry Energy Consumption holds electricity data from a smart small-scale steel plant in South Korea, DAEWOO Steel Co. Ltd in Gwangyang, which makes coils, steel plates and iron plates. The plant's consumption is held in a cloud-based system, and its energy data are kept on the website of the Korea Electric Power Corporation. Sathishkumar V E, Changsun Shin and Yongyun Cho donated it to the UCI Machine Learning Repository in 2023.

Each of the 35,040 instances has a date and nine features: energy consumption in kWh, lagging and leading current reactive power in kVarh, CO2, lagging and leading current power factor, seconds since midnight, a weekday or weekend flag and the day of the week. A load type column marks every record as light, medium or maximum load, and no values are missing.

The repository lists regression as the associated task and links the data to a 2021 paper in Building Research & Information on predicting energy consumption in a smart-city industry building. It is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
